items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued September 28 at 3:55PM EDT until September 29 at 5:00AM EDT by NWS Key West FL
items.description:
* WHAT...Saltwater flooding.

* WHERE...Florida Keys.

* WHEN...Until 5 AM EDT Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Saltwater flooding of low elevation streets and lots
is expected. Some storm drains will overflow, and some seawalls
and docks will be overtopped. Boaters can expect less clearance
under fixed bridges. Motorists should remember that persistent
puddles around the times of high tide are almost certain to
contain a mix of saltwater. In the Upper Keys, little relief can
be expected even outside the hours around high tide.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
items.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.
